title: 06b-B T5: CLI tests for bible-retry and atomic-skip paths
description:
Objective:
Add three CLI integration tests in packages/cli/test/play.test.ts that exercise the new failure modes introduced in T4:
  (a) bible call fails once then succeeds (retry-success): both bible and summary land.
  (b) bible call fails twice (double-failure): warning + atomic skip, no arc_summary row.
  (c) bible succeeds, summary fails: warning + atomic skip, no arc_summary row.

Files:
- Modify: packages/cli/test/play.test.ts

Steps:
1. Add the three new tests (Design field) inside the existing describe('runPlay') block, alongside the existing 'rolls the campaign arc up' and 'skips arc rollup and warns when the model errors during close' tests.
2. The retry-success test will need a stateful bible route that throws on first call and returns valid JSON on second call. Build this with a small closure (see Design).
3. Run: npx vitest run packages/cli/test/play.test.ts --reporter=verbose
   Expected: all tests in this file pass, including the three new ones.
4. Run the full suite: npx vitest run. Expected: all pass.
5. Run: npm run typecheck. Expected: success.
6. Commit:
     git add packages/cli/test/play.test.ts
     git commit -m "Cover bible-extraction retry and atomic-skip paths in CLI tests (loreweaver-5ze)"
acceptance_criteria:
1. The three new tests exist in packages/cli/test/play.test.ts and all pass.
2. The retry-success test verifies bibleCallCount === 2 (one fail + one retry) and no skip warning is written.
3. The bible-double-failure test verifies the 'Arc rollup skipped (bible extraction failed): bible provider down.' warning lands and no arc_summary row exists.
4. The summary-fail test verifies the 'Arc rollup skipped (arc summary failed): summary provider down.' warning lands and no arc_summary OR campaign_bible row exists (atomic skip).
5. If the existing 4ua failure-mode test ('skips arc rollup and warns when the model errors during close') needs to be updated because of message-format changes from T4, the update is included.
6. The full npx vitest run suite passes.
7. npm run typecheck succeeds.
8. The commit message references loreweaver-5ze.
